name: object-subtyping-test-6d097e853f/object-subtyping-v
spec_references: Object/class definitions: "Only `client`, `service` and `isolated` `object-type-quals` / `class-type-quals` are supported"; "Supports `object-field-descriptor`, `method-decl`, `remote-method-decl` and `resource-method-decl` members"
Expressions: "New expression", "Method call", "Field access expression" and "Type test expression"
reason: The case exercises structural object assignability with extra source members, abstract object targets, public objects across modules, module-local members, and a client object assigned to a non-client object target. These use supported class/object members and the supported client qualifier, with no restriction excluding the asserted assignability or method dispatch. Constructors, field access, string construction, integer value:toString calls and assertion logic are supported. All asserted outputs and the client-to-non-client field assertion are in scope.
test_design_notes: The client class declares ordinary methods only; the test asserts assignment compatibility and preservation of the name field, not remote invocation.
